name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9.7-dev.2 (dev build for Osama, 24 Nov 2026): 0.9.7-dev.1 plus the NLOS change (HJ-10, QN-502, CTL-181 and CH-901 rounds use the vanilla Iskander-M guidance: Fire Position, optional laser homing; NLOS code off), the 6 Lynx card models, and the Arsenal textures at 1.5x for the support units, older China models and ZBL-08. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.96.
